content:
No, we cannot buy them from this supplier. 

Under Purchase Policy §6.2 (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and Supplier Policy §4.1 (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that come into contact with food—including 5-litre silicone gaskets (GSK-SIL-05L)—may only be purchased from suppliers holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is lower, an order cannot be placed until a valid certificate is uploaded and verified.
